correctness.rationale: For distinct i,j the only arcs shared by their bidegrees are i→j and j→i. Conditional on these independent Bernoulli variables the four remaining degree counts use disjoint arcs. The centered conditional mean has linear coefficients −d_r b_s, −b_r d_s and mixed coefficient d_r d_s; the two linear coefficients interchange at j. Their orthogonal Bernoulli products give the stated covariance. After weighting, the constant, normalized centered out-/in-degree, and product score form an orthonormal tensor basis of the affected directions. The two linear scores have block n[[1,1],[1,1]], the constant gives zero, the product gives n+n/(n−1), and the orthogonal complement has eigenvalue n. This also gives precisely two null modes, the n=2 multiplicity coincidence, and the sharp variance bound by centering the score; the score r+s attains it. As a separate finite check, fresh exact rational enumeration at n=3, p=2/5 (all 64 digraphs) matched the 9 means and all 81 covariance entries.
residual_risks: The finite reproduction is corroboration only; all-parameter validity uses independent arcs with reverse arcs allowed, no loops, and p strictly between 0 and 1.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The mixed degree calculation covers the entire frozen parameter range and supplies the exact kernel; no extension to a larger size or new model is needed.

evidence: That proof states P(O_i=r,I_j=t) = b_r b_t + pq a_r a_t, with a_r/b_r = (r−mp)/(mpq), after adding back the product marginals. By disjoint arc sets, (O_i,I_j) is independent of (I_i,O_j) for i≠j: outgoing i and incoming j arcs have no overlap with incoming i and outgoing j arcs when loops are absent. Thus the bidegree-pair table is just the product of two copies of precisely that known table, with columns swapped. If u=√b and v=√b(r−mp)/√(mpq), the normalized one-copy kernel is K=uuᵀ+vvᵀ/m. The off-vertex normalized covariance is (K⊗K)S−(u⊗u)(u⊗u)ᵀ, with S the swap. On the constant, symmetric/antisymmetric linear directions, and product direction it has eigenvalues 0, ±1/m, 1/m²; it vanishes on their orthogonal complement. Adding the single-vertex multinomial covariance yields all frozen eigenvalues, rank and the sharp bound by the Rayleigh quotient.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: This uses only independent disjoint coordinate sets, product of two stated exact laws, and diagonalization of a two-vector swap. It is a mechanical consequence of that proof, even though marginal spectra alone would not determine a joint spectrum.
